technical.summary: Long-term trend structure is bullish but price action is weak with bearish momentum indicators, negative CMF, and no confirmed entry signals—confluence insufficient for high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: MTB shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 86 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money conviction to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (33/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional activity and absent news sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (379.5) with imminent FOMC event in 2 days creates severe near-term volatility risk; normal yield curve and flat DXY provide limited offset to acute macro stress.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term trend structure (EMA 50/200 bullish, Supertrend bullish, Ichimoku above cloud) with extreme market fear (33/100) creates contrarian accumulation opportunity near support at 136.92.
debate.key_bear_argument: Acute macro crisis (VIX 379.5, FOMC in 2 days), price below both EMA-9 and EMA-21, negative CMF, bearish MACD histogram, zero fundamental conviction, and no triggered entry strategies make this a high-risk, low-probability swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Long-term trend structure is bullish and price sits at support in extreme fear environment, but acute macro crisis (VIX 379.5, FOMC in 2 days) combined with weak price action (below EMA-9/21, negative CMF, bearish MACD) creates unacceptable near-term volatility risk for swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: FOMC event in 2 days during VIX crisis regime will likely trigger violent repricing; no fundamental or smart money conviction to justify holding through event.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already 12 positions in Financials sector; adding MTB increases concentration risk without offsetting conviction or macro tailwind.
